literal.prompt: Какое высотное первенство принадлежит Антарктиде благодаря мощному ледниковому щиту?

literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP geography L298 directly calls Antarctica the highest continent; L305 reports mean elevation 2,500 m and compares Australia at 330 m. The four alternatives name distinct Antarctic superlatives: temperature, precipitation, mean elevation, wind. Only answer2 is a height ranking. BAS L1 independently reports a mean altitude near2,300m and plateau above2,000m; this approximate value differs from AAP and is kept separate.
literalGroups.locator: AAP geography L298,L302-L305; BAS weather L1.

literalGroups.literal: Антарктида — самый высокий материк в среднем. Мощный ледниковый щит поднимает её среднюю поверхность значительно выше, чем на других материках.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP L298 names the highest continent, L302 says the continent is ice-covered up to4km, and L305 gives a mean elevation of2,500m. The same passage contrasts Australia at330m. BAS L1 independently gives a mean altitude of2,300m, so no false precision is introduced.
literalGroups.locator: AAP geography L298,L302,L305; BAS weather L1.

literalGroups.literal: Антарктида имеет самые низкие зарегистрированные температуры среди материков.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP geography L315 reports the −89.2°C record at Vostok in 1983 and calls Antarctica the coldest continent; AAP weather L334 repeats the record. This is a temperature property, not the height property asked.
literalGroups.locator: AAP geography L313-L315; AAP weather L328-L334.

literalGroups.literal: Антарктида получает крайне мало осадков и считается самым сухим материком.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP geography L298 calls Antarctica the driest continent; L308 says moisture reaching the polar plateau is comparable to the world’s hot deserts. AAP weather L348-L349 says most precipitation is snow/ice crystals and gives annual snow accumulation estimates.
literalGroups.locator: AAP geography L298,L308; AAP weather L344-L349.

literalGroups.literal: Поверхность ледникового щита на высшей точке достигает примерно 4 093 м над уровнем моря.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP geography L305 distinguishes mean Antarctic elevation (2,500m) from the highest point on the icecap (4,093m). The proposed note reports only that icecap surface height, not the highest peak of the continent. BAS L1 reports a separate mean altitude near2,300m and is not used for the exact note figure.
literalGroups.locator: AAP geography L303-L305; BAS weather L1.

literalGroups.literal: На склонах Антарктиды возникают особенно сильные и устойчивые катабатические ветры.
literalGroups.primaryGround: AAP geography L310-L311 calls Antarctica the windiest continent and explains gravity-driven winds down coastal slopes as katabatic; weather L337-L343 describes their consistency and downhill acceleration.
literalGroups.locator: AAP geography L309-L311; AAP weather L335-L343.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.fullPrompt: Какое высотное первенство принадлежит Антарктиде благодаря мощному ледниковому щиту?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.note: Антарктида имеет самые низкие зарегистрированные температуры среди материков.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.grammar: The phrase “самый холодный материк” is a grammatical noun phrase parallel to the other record options; the note is a complete sentence about its own property.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: Cold is a plausible Antarctic superlative, but the prompt asks for a height record; temperature is a separate axis. AAP reports the −89.2°C Vostok record, so the note teaches a true cold fact.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.fullPrompt: Какое высотное первенство принадлежит Антарктиде благодаря мощному ледниковому щиту?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.note: Антарктида получает крайне мало осадков и считается самым сухим материком.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.grammar: “Самый сухой материк” is a grammatical parallel option and the note is a complete statement.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: Dryness is another true Antarctic record but not elevation. AAP calls Antarctica driest and describes little moisture on the plateau; the note is relevant to this option, not a height response.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.fullPrompt: Какое высотное первенство принадлежит Антарктиде благодаря мощному ледниковому щиту?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.note: Поверхность ледникового щита на высшей точке достигает примерно 4 093 м над уровнем моря.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.grammar: “Самый высокий материк в среднем” answers the question about a height record; the proposed note is a full sentence and explicitly limits its subject to the ice-sheet surface.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: It is the only mean-elevation option; the other options concern temperature, precipitation and wind. AAP calls Antarctica the highest continent and reports 2,500m mean elevation. The note adds a distinct icecap-surface fact of about4,093m absent from prompt/key; it does not claim that this is the highest point of the entire continent.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.locator: AAP geography L298,L302-L305, especially L305; BAS L1 for a separate mean estimate.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.fullPrompt: Какое высотное первенство принадлежит Антарктиде благодаря мощному ледниковому щиту?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.note: На склонах Антарктиды возникают особенно сильные и устойчивые катабатические ветры.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.grammar: “Самый ветреный материк” parallels the other superlatives; the note is a complete sentence about winds.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: Wind is a real Antarctic record but a different property. AAP describes katabatic winds flowing down slopes and reports high speeds; this is useful information about its own option.

correctNoteNewFact.fact: Поверхность ледникового щита на высшей точке достигает примерно 4 093 м над уровнем моря.
correctNoteNewFact.locator: AAP geography L303-L305; L305 says the highest point on the icecap is around4,093m above sea level.
correctNoteNewFact.whyAdditional: Concrete icecap-surface elevation absent from prompt and key; it enriches the height option without presenting the icecap point as the highest peak of the whole continent.

absoluteDifficulty.audienceGround: Broad adult audience with basic physical-geography familiarity; remembering the Antarctic mean-elevation superlative is not required by everyday geography.
absoluteDifficulty.judgment: MEDIUM: recognize the mean-elevation record and distinguish it from temperature, precipitation and wind records. This is one coherent geography fact, with no arithmetic or multi-step puzzle.
absoluteDifficulty.supportingEvidence: AAP L298,L302,L305 directly connects the Antarctic ice sheet and mean elevation2,500m. BAS L1 separately estimates mean altitude at2,300m; the candidate keeps these approximate estimates distinct.
